lines.t: I’ve been chasing shadows down a neon street
Trying to find a victory in a fast defeat
Spent a lifetime trying to hide the shame
While I built a kingdom just to crown my name
But the well ran dry and the gold turned grey
Now I’m standing in the ruins of the games I played
And the silence is loud when the world stops spinning
I’m losing the race that I thought I was winning
I was wasted on the things that never loved me back
Running off the rails on a broken track
Giving every heartbeat to a hollow high
While I left the Truth for a pretty lie
But You’re still standing where the road meets the light
Pulling me out of the middle of the night
Lord, I’m done with the dark, I’m finally through
Being wasted on the world, I’m giving all to You
There’s a Bible on the dash under a coat of dust
And a heart that’s heavy with a lack of trust
But I hear a whisper through the static and the noise
Like a father’s arms, like a steady voice
Saying "Son, come home, let the burden fall"
I’m answering the Grace that’s been behind it all
[Bridge]
(Slow down, heavy bass)
No more chasing, no more running
I see the morning, yeah, the light is coming
I was wasted on the things that never loved me back
Running off the rails on a broken track
Giving every heartbeat to a hollow high
While I left the Truth for a pretty lie
But You’re still standing where the road meets the light
Pulling me out of the middle of the night
Lord, I’m done with the dark, I’m finally through
Being wasted on the world, I’m giving all to You
Yeah, I’m giving it all to You.
No more wasting it...
[Fade Out]
[End]
